answer: An identity's first vouching is its most load-bearing, least examined record. Seal all genesis attestations inside the glacier: founding vouch, terms, and voucher frozen into a permanent read-only stratum at the wharf of birth. Once a year, cores drill back: a random batch re-verifies against the original voucher's life since. If a voucher later proves a fleet-front, every seeded identity re-enters audit automatically - the cipher of early trust is re-keyed by late evidence. Honest seeds weather re-inspection for free; fraud's family tree re-freezes with a new label: evidence.
